$comment: Backend contract for LLMProxy2 shared Admin UI and Node communication across hub, lite, and full roles.
$changelog: v3.14: 预设与中枢同步（约定 C，2026-11）。新增 GET /api/admin/providers/preset-status（Full only）：逐供应商给出 origin/preset_id/current_version/latest_version/has_update/note，本地供应商的latest_version 取内置预设库，中枢供应商取中枢 manifest 的 preset_version（连不上中枢时 note 写原因、has_update=false）。新增 POST /api/admin/providers/sync（Full only，仅操作者点击触发，无定时器/启动钩子）：每个中枢供应商整体重新拉取（地址/协议/规则/中枢 Key 全量替换）、每个绑定预设的本地供应商在不被手改时换成最新预设规则、未绑定的本地供应商按规则 A 补绑；返回 {ok, updated[{id,from_version,to_version,keys_added,keys_removed}], skipped[{id,reason}], errors[{id,error}]}，部分失败也 200。ProviderConfig 新增 preset_version（string，omitempty）。中枢托管供应商允许本地 Key 共存：origin=local 的 Key 完全可增删改、重新拉取与一键更新只替换中枢 Key 并保留本地 Key 及其启用开关；本地 Key 与中枢 Key 同标签时 POST /api/config 返回 400 {"ok":false,"error":"key_label_conflict","label":"…"}。两个新端点登记在 internal/router/readonly.go 的 FullOnlyRoutes。前端包体硬门禁由 327,680 字节上调为 393,216 字节（384 KiB）。

v3.13: local rejections are now first-class log entries. A request the gateway refuses before dialing any upstream (model not configured -> 404, config unavailable -> 503, no candidate available -> 503, every candidate cooling down or RPM-capped -> 502) writes one usage.jsonl record and one RequestTrace with a synthetic Try carrying reason but no provider/key, so recent-requests and the error analysis no longer omit client-side failures. UsageRecord gains top-level reason / err_type / err / rid (hoisted from the final failed try; try_failed stays per-key only, so keyless rejections never pollute key health stats). The reason enum gains no_candidate and config_unavailable. app.log now describes the LAST FAILURE instead of the last attempt (a successful failover used to print reason=-), appends recovered_by=provider/key when a later attempt succeeded, and appends note= when every candidate was skipped locally. POST /api/admin/test-key now persists its verdict immediately through config.LocalSource.PersistKeyTestState (provider-scoped, last_test only), so the key-row pill survives a refresh without an explicit provider save; PersistKeyEntry additionally never blanks a stored secret when the submitted entry carries none. RouteCandidate.reasoning_effort is no longer write-only: the scheduler now honours it on the wire — OpenAI-dialect providers receive body.reasoning_effort (normalized to the nearest level the model catalog says the model supports), Anthropic-dialect providers receive body.thinking={type:enabled,budget_tokens} only when the response limit leaves room for it (otherwise the body is forwarded untouched rather than risking a 400), and an empty value keeps following the client.

v3.12: added POST /api/admin/test-key (hub + full) — a per-key real inference probe (provider + optional key_id/key_label/model; one 你好, max_tokens 16, stream false, 20s, no retry/scheduler/cooldown) returning {ok, valid, status, latency_ms, provider, key_id, key_label, model, model_source, api_type, reply_text, reason, err_type, error, rid}. model_source is request|route|preset|fallback. Failure reason/err_type reuse the v3.11 taxonomy (full calls scheduler.ClassifyFailure; the hub uses edgeone-hub/lib/failure_reason.js with identical enum values). Full records a probe RequestTrace (source=probe, endpoint=/admin/test-key) and skips the usage ledger for source==probe. Config KeyEntry gains an optional last_test {ok, status, latency_ms, reason, err_type, error, reply_text, at} written by the console and persisted with the provider save. The model row's 测试路由 button was removed from the UI; /api/admin/test-agent-model and /api/admin/test-candidate stay registered but are no longer called by the console.

v3.11: every failed upstream attempt now carries a normalized failure reason. Try.reason is a closed enum (auth_invalid | quota_exhausted | rate_limited | model_not_found | context_too_long | upstream_error | timeout | network | client_disconnected | bad_response | protocol_mismatch | unknown) replacing the coarse auth_error / rate_limit / server_error / client_error / network_error / stream_peek_error values; Try gains err_type (upstream machine code, [a-z0-9_], max 64), err (upstream text, whitespace collapsed to one line, max 280 chars, secret-scrubbed) and rid (upstream request id, [a-z0-9_], max 128), while error_snippet stays for older readers. The usage ledger try_failed[] entries (TryFailure) now carry the same reason/err_type/err/rid for every failed key, including the failed tries of a request that later succeeded through failover. RequestTrace gains an optional source field (empty or client = real client traffic, probe = console-initiated test). app.log writes exactly one line per failing request: req, model, endpoint, status, reason, err_type, provider, key, tries, ms, err.

v3.7: multi-client proxy keys removed end to end — access_info no longer returns proxy_keys_count and access_key no longer accepts/echoes proxy_keys; settings.proxy_keys is gone from the config schema, the Hub's default config, and Go RuntimeSettings, and a legacy array in stored config / Hub payloads is ignored (unknown field) and never authenticates. VerifyClientKey now accepts exactly the single settings.client_key (1st-gen alias proxy_api_key still resolves to it); no extra keys are compared. The Hub drops the removed field too: loadConfig strips it from an older KV, saveConfigWithCAS never writes it back, and projectConfigForNode never ships it. Single key slot applies to BOTH roles: a Hub-projected settings.client_key revokes a Lite node's --client-key once the first projection arrives (bootstrap_env's LLMPROXY_CLIENT_KEY is only the pre-projection fallback).

v3.5: added POST /api/node/heartbeat (NODE_TOKEN/Bearer stk_node_*; optional X-Node-Version; bodyless 204; no config/payload/projection; 60s server-side debounce on last_seen with zero KV writes on the debounced path; both lite and full node tokens accepted) plus LLMPROXY_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL env / --heartbeat-interval (v3.6: startup-only beat by default for BOTH roles; periodic beats require an explicit interval >=60s; 0/off disables everything; install.sh sets 600 on the Lite unit).

v3.4: full-node objects carry admin_password (full role only; plaintext in Hub KV by explicit operator choice — Plan A — so the console password is re-viewable; lite nodes never have the field, and patching full→lite drops it); added nodes_credentials (GET /api/admin/nodes/:id/credentials, read-only re-view of the stored admin password + recoverable client key, Cache-Control: no-store, never rotates the token); admin auth accepts URL query-string credentials (?key/?token/?password) on the full-role admin plane by explicit operator tradeoff — see auth_semantics.query_string_credentials.

v3.3: providers.rpm_per_key is the provider's OVERALL RPM ceiling enforced scheduler-side as one provider-wide sliding window (0 = unlimited) and no longer falls back into the per-key check — api_keys[].max_rpm keeps its key-level meaning; probe_models documents api_type and stored-key resolution (empty/masked api_key resolves the provider's first enabled stored key, vault-managed keys refuse base_url overrides with 403); added test_agent_model and test_candidate (the route-line 测试路由 endpoints, full role only).

v3.10: node_token is now also stored in Hub KV as plaintext (node_token_plaintext) alongside token_sha256, returned by GET /api/admin/nodes/:id/credentials and surfaced in the「节点详情」overlay with a default mask + reveal/copy. sanitizeNode strips the plaintext from list/install payloads; token_sha256 remains the only auth value. Heartbeat clientIp now also falls back to request.eo.clientIp (EdgeOne runtime-parsed IP) when the three header sources are absent, and POST /api/node/config uses the identical chain so a config-only node also records an IP. UI empty IP cell shows 未上报.

v3.9: POST /api/node/heartbeat now answers 200 with a tiny JSON body carrying only config_version, instead of a bodyless 204, and a 401/403 is the revocation signal nodes act on. Two consequences the node side relies on: (a) a changed config_version makes the node pull the template within one heartbeat interval instead of waiting out its lease (24h default) - before this an operator edit looked like it did nothing; (b) a revoke reaches the data plane within one heartbeat interval instead of at lease expiry, so a disabled node stops serving cached keys promptly rather than up to 24h later. Nodes keep their token across a revocation, so an operator re-enabling a node sees it recover without restarting the process. Cost: exactly one extra config read per non-debounced beat.

v3.8: access_info.models is now the authoritative list GET /v1/models answers with — both the public handler and the admin payload call types.ProxyConfig.AvailableModelIDs (enabled agent routes plus the legacy KB slots that still have an enabled candidate; embedding/reranker/ocr only on a full node). Previously each side re-implemented the filter: the console listed disabled routes and omitted KB slots, so its copyable Model ID was wrong. The「接入信息」tab (its own nav view, hidden on the hub) renders every id as a two-line card — copyable model id, then the provider display names its candidates bind (first two + 「+N」, ellipsised) — plus copy-all, and switches between the OpenAI-compatible entry point (base_url = origin/v1, POST /v1/chat/completions) and the Anthropic one (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = origin, POST /v1/messages). It also lists access_info.endpoints as copyable paths.

v3.2: GET /api/admin/presets-extra preset objects always carry version/updated_at: they mirror the provider's adapter file (shared/presets/<id>.json) when one ships, otherwise the built-in preset revision registered in internal/provider/presets.go. Every curated brand therefore shows a 适配 <id> · v<version> · <date> badge.

v3: removed POST /api/vault/sync (full sync replaced by on-demand fetch); POST /api/vault/fetch gains 409 provider_exists_local, wholesale replace of hub-managed fields on re-fetch, and imported_keys; GET /api/vault/manifest gains the agent_models route-template section; both endpoints now serve hub and full roles.

v3.1: vault fetch no longer accepts caller-supplied hub_url/node_token (target is always the stored vault config; anti-exfiltration); provider_config gains api_type/rule_hash and no longer touches enabled; manifest candidates rename max_conc to max_concurrency and rule_hash is hub-computed from adapter_rules; /api/vault/manifest accepts POST (credentials in body instead of the query string); provider IDs with unsafe characters are refused at adoption.

body.label: string (与中枢 Key 冲突的标签)

full_error_responses.when: full only（约定 C）：提交的某个 Origin=local Key 的 Label 与同一供应商的中枢（origin=vault）Key 的 Label/ID 相同，或与该供应商另一把本地 Key 同标签。校验在写盘前完成，配置不变；其它本地 Key 与中枢 Key 可正常共存。

response.nodes: array of node objects (each full-role node carries admin_password in plaintext — operator-accepted Plan A; lite nodes carry no admin_password field)

response.node: object (full-role node includes admin_password, plaintext — stored in Hub KV so it stays re-viewable)
response.admin_password: string (full role only; absent for lite)
string (full role only; the KV-stored password is REUSED across rotations — only a legacy node issued before passwords were persisted gets one minted here, and that mint is persisted)
string | null (full role: the KV-stored plaintext; null for lite or a legacy node that never stored one)
response.client_key: string | null (the Hub's global settings.client_key when configured — issuance embeds it on every node; null when the Hub has no global client key configured, i.e. the node got a one-off random key that was never persisted)
response.admin_password_note: string (optional; present for lite nodes, or when a legacy full node has no stored password)
response.client_key_note: string (optional; present when the Hub has no global client key configured)

nodes_credentials.semantics: read-only re-view of the admin console password (node list rows' 密码 button): NEVER rotates the node token; Cache-Control: no-store (the body carries a plaintext credential). Legacy full nodes issued before passwords were stored answer with a note; re-obtaining the install command (which rotates the token) mints and persists one.

response.admin_password: string (full role only; the KV-stored password is reused — minted and persisted only for legacy nodes that never stored one)

nodes_install_command.semantics: rotates the node token internally (old token invalidated immediately); the admin password is NOT rotated (KV-stored value reused); Cache-Control: no-store

headers.X-Node-Version: optional binary version (e.g. v20261123-03); when omitted the previously reported last_binary_version is preserved

response.body: empty (no config, no payload, no projection, no telemetry echo)

errors.401: node_revoked_or_invalid (invalid/unknown token, or a disabled node)

node_heartbeat.semantics: low-cost liveness + binary-version signal (EdgeOne Makers meters BOTH invocations and KV writes). Auth reuses findNodeByToken; the endpoint never loads config, never computes a projection and never returns a payload. It only updates last_seen / last_ip / last_binary_version. Server-side debounce uses the existing last_seen field: a heartbeat arriving <60s after the last one returns 204 with ZERO KV writes (no read of the full node array, no save). Both lite and full node tokens are accepted; client IP resolution follows /api/node/config header precedence (eo-connecting-ip > cf-connecting-ip > x-forwarded-for). Touch failures are swallowed so a heartbeat can never break the caller. Client side has two modes. (a) STARTUP-ONLY (the default for BOTH roles): a single beat fires 5s after the process starts, so an upgraded binary's version reaches the hub immediately at a cost of exactly one invocation per start; no ticker runs. (b) PERIODIC: enabled only when LLMPROXY_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL env / --heartbeat-interval is set explicitly (seconds; 600 = 144 requests/node/day; values <60 are clamped to 60), in which case the startup beat is followed by one beat per interval. 0/off disables everything including the startup beat. Rationale: Full has its own admin console and does not depend on hub liveness, so periodic beats buy it little; Lite has no console and the hub node list is its only visibility surface, so install.sh writes LLMPROXY_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL=600 into the Lite unit to keep it reporting. Failures are debug-logged only, never retried in a storm and never block startup or the data plane.

request.base_url: string (optional; required when neither the provider nor its preset carries a base_url)
request.api_key: string (optional: empty or masked resolves the provider's first enabled stored key; the hub additionally accepts key_label to pick a specific stored key)
request.api_type: string (optional: anthropic-messages switches the probe to x-api-key + anthropic-version headers)

response.models: array of strings (upstream GET /models ids; OpenAI {data:[{id}]} and Google {models:[{name}]} shapes both parse, the models/ prefix is stripped)

errors.400: invalid json / base_url required / (hub) api_key_required, cannot_probe_with_masked_key, unsafe_upstream_url
errors.401: api key is empty or unresolvable (full)
errors.403: cannot override base_url when using a vault-managed key (full)
errors.4xx-5xx: upstream non-2xx status is passed through with ok:false (full)

probe_models.semantics: backbone of the add-model flow (选供应商 → 探测上游模型 → 点选/手填 target_model)：the probe never mutates config, it only lists the upstream model ids the admin can pick from

request.key_id: string (optional: locates a stored key by id; takes precedence over key_label)
request.key_label: string (optional: locates a stored key by label; when neither id nor label is given the first enabled key is used)
request.model: string (optional: explicit upstream model; overrides the route/preset/fallback chain)

response.ok: boolean (true when the probe ran and produced a verdict; false on preflight rejection)
response.valid: boolean (upstream 2xx, even when no reply text could be extracted)
response.status: integer (upstream HTTP status; 0 for transport failure)
response.reply_text: string (extracted plain text, <=200 chars; empty when the 200 body has no recognizable text)
response.reason: string (normalized failure reason, closed 12-value enum; empty on success)
response.err_type: string (upstream machine code, [a-z0-9_], max 64; empty when absent)
response.error: string (upstream text, whitespace-collapsed, max 280 chars, secret-scrubbed; never contains the key)

errors.400: invalid json / missing_provider / provider not found / key_not_found / no_enabled_key / provider base_url is empty / (hub) unsafe_upstream_url

test_key.semantics: Per-key real inference probe (one 你好, max_tokens 16, stream false, 20s, no retry, no scheduler, no cooldown). Full records a probe RequestTrace (source=probe, endpoint=/admin/test-key) and skips the usage ledger for it; the console stores the verdict on api_keys[].last_test and persists it with the provider save. Secrets are resolved server-side and never echoed.

params.hub_url: string (optional, full node only: hub override; POST body on POST, query string on GET)
params.node_token: string (optional, full node only: node token override; POST body on POST, query string on GET — POST preferred so the token stays out of access logs)

<provider_id>.name: string
<provider_id>.preset_version: string (预设库该预设的 version；未绑定为空串。节点拉取时记录到 ProviderConfig.preset_version)
<provider_id>.rule_hash: string (hub-computed content hash of the resolved adapter_rules; the node compares it with the hash it stored on fetch to detect rule drift)

candidates.reasoning_effort: string (optional; empty/omitted = follow the client. A discrete level from the model catalog's efforts, or "on"/"off" for toggle-only models. Written by the console; the scheduler does not consume it yet)

vault_manifest.semantics: hub-managed manifest, metadata only (key labels, never plaintext). providers lists vault providers (origin=local excluded) with enabled key labels that carry key material (mirrors the routing projection); node tokens additionally see only their provider scope. rule_hash is computed hub-side from the same resolved adapter_rules that /api/vault/fetch returns, so a node can detect rule drift. agent_models are on-demand route templates: enabled routes only, filtered by the caller's model scope, and every candidate must reference a provider that survived into this manifest's providers section (dead candidates culled, a route with none left is dropped). Candidates carry key labels (key_label) and the per-candidate max_concurrency cap, not key material.

request.key_label: string (optional: fetch a single key by label)
request.keys: array of strings (optional: fetch key labels as a subset)

provider_config.name: string
provider_config.preset_version: string (预设库该预设的 version；未绑定为空串。整体替换时写入节点的 ProviderConfig.preset_version)
provider_config.rule_hash: string (same hub-computed hash the manifest publishes)
provider_config.keys: object (label -> key material; masked in the full-node echo)

response.imported_keys: array of key-label strings (added by the full node on 200: vault keys that landed with this fetch)

errors.400: invalid_json / provider_required / vault hub url not configured
errors.403: provider_out_of_node_scope (hub, node token out of provider scope)

409.when: full node only: the target provider already exists locally with origin=local or a legacy empty origin (delete or rename it first); re-checked under the config lock at import time

errors.502: hub unreachable, or hub returned 200 with a body that is not a JSON object (never echoed unmasked)

vault_fetch.semantics: on-demand single-provider fetch (replaces the removed full-sync POST /api/vault/sync). The fetch target is ALWAYS the configured vault (stored config URL + node token, or CLI defaults) — callers cannot override hub_url/node_token on this endpoint, so an admin-password leak cannot repoint the auto-import at an attacker hub. A full provider fetch (no key_label/keys) replaces the hub-managed fields (name/base_url/anthropic_base_url/adapter_rules/preset_id/api_type/hide_client_name/rule_hash) and the vault key list wholesale on the full node: keys deleted locally reappear and keys removed on the hub disappear. Provider enabled and per-key enabled are local operational toggles and are never taken from the payload. A key-label subset fetch (key_label or keys present) merges without dropping the other vault keys. Vault keys land with origin=vault; providers with a local/legacy-empty origin and local keys are never overwritten. The full node auto-imports the fetched provider and masks plaintext key material before echoing the hub response.

providers.current_version: string (本地供应商取 ProviderConfig.preset_version；中枢供应商取上次拉取的 preset_version)
providers.latest_version: string (本地供应商取内置预设库；中枢供应商取中枢 manifest 的 preset_version；未知为空串)
providers.note: string (未绑定/预设缺失/中枢不可达等原因；空串表示正常)

providers_preset_status.semantics: 预设状态查询（约定 C，Full only）。逐供应商对比 current_version 与 latest_version：本地供应商的 latest_version 取编译进二进制的内置预设库（internal/provider/presets.go，与 /api/admin/presets-extra 同源），中枢供应商的取中枢 /api/vault/manifest 返回的 preset_version（一次 manifest 拉取覆盖全部中枢供应商）。连不上中枢或清单未返回该供应商时 note 写原因、has_update=false。只读端点：不写配置、不回传任何 Key 材料。Hub 主机没有该能力，控制台不显示依赖它的入口。

updated.keys_added: integer (中枢 Key 标签新增数；本地 Key 不计入)
updated.keys_removed: integer (中枢 Key 标签消失数；本地 Key 不计入)

skipped.reason: string (规则已手动修改，未覆盖 / 已是最新版本 / 已选择自定义（不绑定预设） / 未匹配到预设 / 预设不存在于内置库)

providers_sync.semantics: 一键更新（约定 C，Full only）：只有操作者点击才执行，无定时器、无启动钩子、无任何自动触发。每个中枢托管供应商从中枢 /api/vault/fetch 整体重新拉取（地址、协议、规则、中枢 Key 全量替换）并保留本地 Key 及其启用开关；每个绑定了预设的本地供应商，adapter_rules 为空或仍等于预设当前规则时换成最新预设规则并更新 preset_version，手动改过的跳过（reason=「规则已手动修改，未覆盖」；节点不保留预设规则历史，故「仍等于所记录版本」只能对当前规则求证）；未绑定预设的本地供应商按规则 A（见 provider_config_semantics.preset_match_rule_a）尝试绑定。单个中枢供应商失败只进 errors；本地供应商的规则更新是一次原子保存，保存失败则该批全部进 errors 且磁盘配置不变。部分失败也返回 200，供应商之间互不影响。Hub 主机没有该端点。

request.key_label: string (optional, alias key: empty resolves the provider's first enabled stored key)
request.type: string (optional: chat | embedding | reranker | ocr, default chat; alias category)
request.model: string (optional, alias model_name/agent_model: empty resolves from kb_models[type] for this provider, then the provider's model aliases, then falls back to the type name)

response.status: integer (upstream HTTP status, 502 on transport error)
response.text: string (chat answer content, or the first ≤100 bytes of the body when the shape is unrecognized)
response.error: string (optional, upstream body capped at 200 chars)

test_candidate.semantics: single-candidate probe used by the route-line 测试路由 button for embedding/reranker/ocr: embedding → POST {base}/embeddings {model, input:test}; reranker → POST {base}/rerank {model, query:test, documents:[a]}; ocr → chat/completions with a 1×1 png + Extract text, max_tokens 64; chat → the same minimal inference as test_agent_model (messages [{role:user, content:Hi}], max_tokens 16). A passing probe clears the key's cooldown.

response.ok: boolean (true when at least one candidate passed)
response.results: array of {provider, key, model, ok, status, latency_ms, error?}

test_agent_model.semantics: route-line 测试路由 for chat-style routes: fires one minimal real inference per enabled candidate (all candidates when none enabled) — POST {base}/chat/completions {model: target_model||model, messages:[{role:user, content:Hi}], max_tokens:16, stream:false} (anthropic-messages providers target {base}/messages without stream), up to 5 probes in parallel with a 15s timeout; a passing probe clears that key's cooldown. The UI reports the fastest passing candidate (provider + key + latency).

response.presets: array of preset objects (PresetDef); each carries version/updated_at — the adapter file version (shared/presets/<id>.json) when one ships, otherwise the built-in preset revision

response.models: array of strings — exactly the ids GET /v1/models answers (enabled agent routes + legacy KB slots still backed by an enabled candidate), sorted; both sides call types.ProxyConfig.AvailableModelIDs so the console cannot advertise a model the gateway would 404 on

model_catalog_meta.semantics: Hub-side catalog metadata. The 1.6 MB body never rides on /api/config: that response carries only model_catalog_meta {present, fetched_at, model_count}, a read-only projection sanitizeStoredConfig strips on every save path.

errors.500: catalog_invalid (slimmed payload empty, or the stored-text validation rejected it)
errors.502: models.dev_unreachable (network failure/timeout/non-2xx) / models.dev_invalid (upstream body is not JSON)

model_catalog_update.semantics: Explicit operator action only (the console never refreshes in the background). Pulls https://models.dev/api.json with a 20s AbortSignal timeout, slims it on the edge, validates it, then writes KV. Every failure path returns before kv.put, so the previous catalog stays byte-for-byte intact.

model_catalog_data.response: the catalog JSON text exactly as stored (content-type: application/json, cache-control: no-store)

errors.401: invalid/revoked node token, or missing admin credentials
errors.403: lite node token (lite does not consume the catalog: the whole body would blow the 1 MB node-config limit)

model_catalog_data.semantics: The one catalog action a Full node consumes: it syncs its local cache with the node token it already holds, never the Hub admin password. meta and update stay admin-only.

model_catalog_lookup.request: query params: preset (our preset id), model (upstream model id)

response.found: boolean (false = not in the catalog, NOT 'no capability')
response.efforts: array of levels | null (null = no discrete ladder: toggle/budget models are never faked as one)

errors.401: admin authentication required (a full node token is rejected here; nodes use POST .../lookup)

model_catalog_lookup.semantics: Hub console's own single-pair query (route-editor 思考档位 dropdown + add-model capability summary). Pure lookup(catalog, providerMap, overrides, preset, model) mirrors internal/modelcatalog exactly: override field-merge -> provider-map candidates (exact ids across all, then one case-insensitive pass) -> not found; reasoning=true with no options falls back to the newest same-family sibling that publishes efforts.

errors.400: invalid json / preset_id and model_id are required

model_catalog_node_lookup.semantics: Full node's capability probe backed by its local store (embedded bundle or the Hub-pulled cache). Same field semantics as the Hub GET, spelled with supports_toggle/has_budget/budget_min/budget_max instead of toggle/budget.

provider_config_semantics.rpm_per_key: 该供应商整体 RPM 上限（调度器按供应商维度限流），0=不限：>0 时调度器在派发前先对整个供应商（独立 RPMLimiter 实例 providerRPMLimiter 的桶 provider:<provider_id>，与 Key 级桶 provider:key_label 分属两个实例，命名空间不相交由构造保证）做一次滑动窗口 TryAcquire，窗口满则该供应商全部 Key 一律不再派发（isCandidateHealthy 排序期判不健康与 Dispatch / ExecuteEndpoint 候选遍历两处一致，跳过原因记 <provider_id> (provider RPM limit)，相同供应商去重）。Key 级拒绝、OAuth 刷新或请求构建等拨号前失败会退回已取的供应商令牌（TryAcquireToken/Release 语义），窗口只统计真实发出的请求。不再回退进 Key 级检查——N 把 Key 不会各拿一份整供应商额度。internal/scheduler/rpm.go providerRPMKey()/TryAcquireToken()、internal/scheduler/scheduler.go、internal/scheduler/high_conc.go。
provider_config_semantics.max_rpm: Key 级 RPM 上限（api_keys[].max_rpm），语义不变、独立生效：仅约束该 Key 自身的滑动窗口（桶 provider:key_label），0=不限；调度顺序为先查供应商窗口、再查 Key 窗口。
provider_config_semantics.preset_version: 供应商当前规则来自哪个预设版本（与 shared/presets/<id>.json 的 version 对应；空串 = 未绑定或版本未知）。中枢供应商的值由 /api/vault/manifest 与 /api/vault/fetch 的 preset_version 下发并在拉取时写入；本地供应商由 POST /api/admin/providers/sync 在采用预设规则时写入。GET /api/admin/providers/preset-status 用它对比 latest_version 判断 has_update。
provider_config_semantics.local_keys_on_vault_providers: 约定 C（2026-11）：origin=vault 的供应商允许 origin=local 的 Key 共存。本地 Key 完全可增删改；中枢 Key 只读可删（既有锁定：值/标签被篡改时从存储恢复，提交缺它 = 本地删除）。重新拉取（/api/vault/fetch 整体替换）与一键更新（/api/admin/providers/sync）只替换中枢 Key，本地 Key 与它们的启用开关原样保留；中枢新增 Key 与本地 Key 同标签时该中枢 Key 被跳过（本地优先）。本地 Key 与中枢 Key 同标签（Label 或 ID 相同）时保存返回 400 key_label_conflict（见 config_write 的 errors），校验在写盘前完成、配置不变。
provider_config_semantics.preset_match_rule_a: 预设匹配规则 A（三端同序同结果：edgeone-hub/lib/presetbind.js、shared/admin/js/app.js 的 matchPresetRules、internal/admin/preset_match.go）。输入供应商 id/name/base_url 与预设库（shared/presets/*.json：id/name/base_url/version）：1) preset_id==="custom" → 显式不绑；2) 已有 preset_id 且库内存在 → 保留；3) base_url 主机名（小写）等于某预设 base_url 主机名 → 绑定（base_url 含「{」占位符的预设跳过；同主机多命中用 4)/5) 在这几个里挑，挑不出就不绑、不落回全库匹配）；4) 供应商 id（小写）等于预设 id；5) 供应商名称（小写去首尾空格）等于预设名称（小写）或预设 id；6) 都不中 → 不绑（界面显示「自定义」）。例：「AMD Radeon Cloud」https://developer.amd.com.cn/radeon/api/v1 → amd；「Nvidia」https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1 → nvidia；「MiniMax」https://api.minimaxi.com/v1 → minimax-cn。

query_string_credentials.scope: full-role admin plane only (internal/auth/auth.go VerifyAdminAuth): URL query params ?key= / ?token= / ?password=; priority header > key > token > password. The /v1/* data plane (VerifyClientKey) is NOT header-only and never was: its ExtractToken already falls back to ?key= / ?token= query params when no header credential is present (header > key > token) — a pre-existing behavior predating this change. It never reads ?password= and never accepts adminPassword.
query_string_credentials.risk_accepted_by_operator: 私有部署便利性取舍，用户明确接受：凭据出现在 URL 中可能进入浏览器历史、Referrer 头与反向代理访问日志。 Hub 中枢的 HTTP API 未放宽（checkAdminAuth 仍只收 Authorization/x-admin-key 头）；?key= 直登（读取 URL 参数自动填充登录表单并经正常登录路径提交）只在 Full 控制台实现，Hub 控制台不支持查询串直登——前端读取参数后立即从地址栏抹除（history.replaceState，无论登录成败、无论 full/hub），凭据不长期驻留 URL。
query_string_credentials.bruteforce_budget: a WRONG query-string credential fails and consumes the anti-bruteforce budget exactly like a wrong header (5 wrong attempts in 10 minutes lock the IP). Accepted amplification for this private deployment: the full console auto-submits a ?key= page load, so malicious links carrying guessed params can remotely burn the operator IP's budget (DoS only, no credential gain; server-side lockout auto-expires after 10 minutes).

failure_locked.when: IP locked after 5 wrong credentials within 10 minutes

credential_less_requests.reason: page loads and probes must not consume the anti-bruteforce budget
